name: io.github.dharundp6/jev-carryforward
title: carryforward
description: What your last session knew, scored against what this one is doing. A per-project ledger written as things happen, recalled per task with TypeSafe's Jev evaluation model.

environmentVariables.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Vercel AI Gateway key used to reach the Jev scorer. Optional: without it recall returns the whole ledger and says so.

environmentVariables.name: CARRYFORWARD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the per-project ledgers. Defaults to ~/.carryforward.

environmentVariables.name: CARRYFORWARD_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Ledger name for this project. Defaults to a slug of the working directory.
